offering_description.value: Brown & Brown arranges commercial and personal insurance and provides employee benefits and risk management advice to businesses and individuals. It also distributes specialty insurance programs, working with insurers and wholesale and retail brokers and serving some customers directly.

quotes.quote: Brown & Brown brings insurance, risk management, and employee benefits together to help businesses and individuals navigate risk with confidence and clarity. No matter where you are on your growth journey – whether you are a highly complex multinational enterprise, an individual, or anything in between – our experienced teams can help find solutions at every stage.

Our specialty insurance distribution platform is purpose-built to support every participant in the insurance ecosystem. We deliver tailored solutions for insurance carriers, wholesale and retail brokers, as well as organizations and individuals directly seeking specialized insurance coverage.
